claims.explanation: PF-562271 is a dual FAK/Pyk2 (PTK2/PTK2B) inhibitor, so selectivity is most plausibly driven by dependence on FAK/Pyk2 signaling rather than by a single lineage. Lines with high PTK2/PTK2B expression, mesenchymal/EMT-like or adhesion/integrin-driven programs, and intact downstream FAK signaling should be sensitized, whereas lines with low FAK pathway activity or compensatory RTK/PI3K-MAPK activation (e.g., EGFR/BRAF/PIK3CA-mutant, PTEN-mutant lines) tend to be protected. The observed enrichment of TP53-mutant, mesenchymal-like sarcoma/squamous lines and the virtual-cell similarity to CDK/PKC inhibitors support a FAK-dependent, EMT/adhesion-linked vulnerability.

features.basis: FAK is the primary drug target; high PTK2 expression predicts dependence and sensitivity (PMID 23536552, 19740433)
Pyk2 is the second annotated target and contributes to FAK/Pyk2-dependent signaling (PMID 27796369)
Epithelial/E-cadherin-high lines are less FAK/EMT-dependent and less sensitive (PMID 20802523, 28405684)
Mesenchymal/EMT phenotype increases FAK-dependent invasion and drug response (PMID 20802523, 28405684)
EGFR-mutant NSCLC lines (NCIH1650, NCIH1648, HCC4006) are among least affected, suggesting EGFR-driven bypass signaling
BRAF-mutant melanoma/colorectal lines (IGR37, UACC62, SNUC5) are less affected, consistent with MAPK-driven bypass
PTEN loss activates PI3K/AKT and may reduce dependence on FAK survival signaling (seen in ZR751, UACC62, 786O)
Most selectively killed lines carry TP53 mutations, though this may reflect the screened lineage composition rather than a direct mechanism
NF1-mutant lines appear in both extremes, but RAS-pathway activation can bypass FAK dependence
SMARCA4-mutant squamous/ovarian lines (KYSE270, OV7) are enriched among sensitive lines, possibly via adhesion/EMT remodeling
CDKN2A loss appears in several sensitive sarcoma/melanoma lines, consistent with cell-cycle deregulation enhancing FAK-inhibitor response
MET-mutant HGC27 is among the most killed lines; MET-integrin crosstalk may increase FAK dependence
